edit.description: narrow the three existsSync gates to ENOENT

summary: job.ts's existsSync gates read a non-ENOENT stat failure as absent: a live loop reads dead, an unreadable awake dir reads hibernating or aborts the enumeration
tests: liveLoopPid rethrows a non-ENOENT stat failure instead of reading the pidfile as absent
jobStatus reports a job whose awake dir cannot be read as a null awake, not as hibernating
jobStatus never hides sibling jobs when one job's awake dir cannot be read
jobStatus rethrows a non-ENOENT read failure on the jobs root instead of reporting no jobs
flume job status renders a null awake as unreadable, distinct from a hibernating job
acceptance: Every existsSync gate in src/job.ts narrows to ENOENT; EACCES on loop.pid, awake/ or .flume/jobs surfaces instead of reading as absent.
notes: Same ENOENT narrowing readPendingLoose/countFrictionFiles already do here (per JOB-READPENDINGLOOSE-NARROW-ENOENT). Sites: src/job.ts:331 liveLoopPid, :523 jobsRoot, :530 awake guard. Measured EACCES, Linux: liveLoopPid returns null over a live pid, so jobRm's refusal and cli.ts:826's lock claim both miss; an unreadable awake/ throws out of the map; an untraversable jobDir reads awake []. awake widens to string[] | null, rendered like frictionCount's 'friction: unreadable'.
